protocol: All candidate mixing weights below are evaluated only on public GOT-10k validation calibration IDs (numeric ID modulo 3 equals 1). The entropy threshold is derived solely from node-7 passive calibration logs.
threshold_rule: coordinate entropy q0.85 of node-7 calibration logs
selection_rule: Choose the alpha with the largest calibration frame-weighted AO improvement over its immutable-baseline partition result; break exact ties toward smaller alpha. The chosen alpha must be frozen in preselection.json before selection runs.

runtime_invariants.motion_prior: one-step constant-velocity xywh extrapolation from two previous accepted tracker states
runtime_invariants.high_entropy_action: mix model mapped xywh state with motion prior using alpha
runtime_invariants.low_entropy_action: delegate the model mapped xywh state unchanged
